notes.title: Relinquished: Souls Asylum Available Today
notes.content: [p]Trapped in a haunted house. No memories. No way out… unless you find one.[/p][p][i]Relinquished: Souls Asylum[/i] launches today! Uncover the truth, survive the horrors within, and escape with your life—if you can.[/p][p]To celebrate release day, enjoy a [b]limited-time launch discount[/b]. Don’t miss your chance to experience the terror at a lower price![/p]
